title: Largest Sum of Averages
goal: Partition positive values into at most k contiguous groups to maximize the sum of group averages.
strategy: With positive values, splitting a group cannot decrease the total average sum, so an optimum uses k groups. Prefix sums price each final group while DP tries all earlier split positions.
